name: Rubescent-Reach
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, massive canyon systems emerge like the bones of the planet.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on copper, silicon, solar potential and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
